verdict.rationale: Data region/residency selection is a fair question for a cloud software-development platform like Factory, but the evidence pack never documents choosing a storage region or residency. Bring Your Own Machine lets you register your own machine for running Droid sessions. That controls where compute happens, not where Factory stores data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
